name: Illusion Jewellery
description:
We are specialize for manufacturing of ILLUSION SOLITAIRE NATURAL DIAMOND JEWELRIES, which is most innovative concept of our diamond industry up to date. These ILLUSION DIAMONDS are specially cut from Rough Diamond into unique shapes ranging from 3 Pieces to 9 Pieces. It is set with special setting technique so it does not have any gap, metal & prong between ILLUSION DIAMONDS. Because of this, there will not be any dust collection on this ILLUSION DIAMONDS so it will look like a solitaire diamond forever. It looks very close to the solitaire diamond & it will look like a solitaire even in 3cts, 5cts or even bigger than that look.
These ILLUSION JEWELLERY are approximately 80% to 90% less priced compared with Solitaire Diamond.
